description.narrative: Main activities and objectives under the Institutional Strengthening Project Phase I are as follows: - 1. Upgrading of the recovery and recycling (R<(>&<)>R) scheme: monitor R<(>&<)>R quantities; survey on existing capacities for refrigerants R <(>&<)>R; develop plan for upgrading the R<(>&<)>R scheme, define criteria for selection of entities/service shops to be granted with R<(>&<)>R equipment; implement the procedure for the stakeholders/entities selection (publish public announcement, establish selection commission); define a list of equipment to be included in the R<(>&<)>R set; purchastr and distirbute the R<(>&<)>R equipment purchasing - 2. Establishment of sustainable training centres: create a list of newly-established training centres; assess the training centres' needs in regards to the demonstration equipment; define a list of equipment to be included in the demonstration set; purchase and install the demonstration equipment; organize the traning on how to operate the demonstration equipment; PMU-project monitoring
